sources.name: Island Tree 02
sources.author: Rob Tuytel (scanning, processing); Rico Cilliers (cleanup, processing) / Poly Haven

steps: Center geometry at ground level; preserve original downloads unchanged in ignored source folder.
Join by material and weld. Simplify structural trunk/branch geometry into near/far LODs.

Fit alpha-textured quads to connected photographic leaves using UV/position covariance. Preserve the spatial leaf distribution: near canopy samples one in two source leaves with 1.45x card coverage, far samples one in six with 2.1x coverage. This avoids destroying foliage mass during global simplification.

Derive a compact hedge from the source coastal-tree leaf distribution with flattened vertical scale. Near hedge samples one leaf in six with 2.2x card coverage; far one in eighteen with 3.7x coverage. Matched camera review confirms full-looking foliage.
Resize images to at most 1024px; pack the supplied photographic alpha mask into foliage albedo. Retain bark/leaf textures.
Combine both LODs in one GLB with deduplicated embedded textures. All runtime requests use local files.
Use matte foliage PBR with specular antialiasing, a subdued normal map and thin-leaf translucency; retain detailed branching trunks. Palm crown spread is increased 25% without stretching its trunk.
processing.privacy: No owner footage, frame, real house layout or people used in these vegetation assets.

distantTier.inputs: The three previously approved near/mid runtime GLBs above; their SHA-256 hashes remain unchanged.
steps: Retain only the existing far geometry and derive a separate third tier. No source download, new external asset or owner media is used.

Preserve complete solid palm leaflets with alternating spatial sampling; widen across each leaflet while retaining frond length and original primitive bounds. Omit subpixel date fruit. Simplify structural bark.
Retain one in five canopy photographic alpha cards and one in four hedge cards, enlarging retained cards to preserve distant crown coverage; simplify canopy structure.

Retain local embedded base-colour/alpha images at at most 512px. Drop detailed normal, metalness, occlusion and emission textures from distant materials. Near/mid geometry and textures are byte-identical.

runtime.instances: Native GPU instancing, three per-instance distance tiers and chunk disposal; nearby shadow filtering at most every 200ms, skipped when the camera and chunk membership are unchanged. One hedge instance replaces the historical six-branch assembly.
runtime.distantMaterial: Separate matte PBR materials: no normal/metalness/AO maps or leaf translucency; distant source meshes disable shadow reception. Near and mid materials remain unchanged.
